title: Bayan and the Returning Voice
logline: Bayan calls into the world and learns that every voice comes home.
story: At the rim of the great valley where Sidqi, who was a man of observant quiet, whose ground has softened, was said to dwell, Bayan — carrying clarity, the inner word — shouted a harsh word into the dark, and a harsh word came back; then Bayan shouted a kind one, and kindness returned. For a long while Bayan only listened to the echoes, learning their quiet law. By dusk Bayan understood that the valley had never invented a single sound — it had only returned what was given. Bayan walked home speaking gently, knowing the world was an honest mirror.
moral: Whatever you send into the world returns to you; the world keeps no other ledger.
